model.description: The embedding model id. Default onnx-community/granite-embedding-small-english-r2-ONNX. mock embeds offline.

dtype.description: The weight quantization the model loads at. Default q8.

cacheDir.description: Where computed vectors are cached, relative to the working directory. Default .manni/vector/cache.

byLanguage.description: The model and quantization for one language, keyed by BCP-47 tag and matched canonically.
